traits.stipe_scale_extent.note: Flora of North America (vol. 2), Blechnum spicant: "Petioles of fertile leaves reddish brown to purple-black, 15-60 cm, coarsely scaly proximally. Petioles of sterile leaves reddish brown, 2-30 cm, coarsely scaly proximally." Read as base.

traits.stipe_colour.note: Flora of North America (vol. 2), Blechnum spicant: "Petioles of fertile leaves reddish brown to purple-black, 15-60 cm, coarsely scaly proximally. Petioles of sterile leaves reddish brown, 2-30 cm, coarsely scaly proximally." Read as a reddish brown, the sterile fronds' and most fertile ones'.

traits.leaf_length_m.note: FEIS's deer fern review (Matthews 1993, read 2026-10-15): fronds dimorphic; the sterile ones evergreen, spreading or pressed to the ground, usually 4 to 16 inches (10-40 cm) long; the fertile ones fewer, deciduous and much longer. The stated 13-80 cm spans both.

traits.note: Abrams's flora (vol. 1, 1923; ferns by Maxon), under Struthiopteris spicant: a short-creeping woody rhizome; sterile fronds many, in a ring, spreading or ascending, 15 to 100 cm, evergreen; their stipes 2 to 30 cm; blades linear to linear-oblanceolate, 13 to 80 cm by 2 to 9 cm, cut to the midrib into 30 to 80 pairs of segments (pinnate at the base), which are stated here as a once-pinnate blade's leaflets, as the program draws them; fertile fronds few, central, erect, 40 to 150 cm, with very narrow, distant pinnae. The sizes here are the sterile fronds'.

generator.params.note: Hand-set from general knowledge of the species: a small evergreen fern: a flat rosette of narrow, ladder-like, once-divided fronds with rounded pinnae. Not fitted to measurements.

allometry.note: Rough sizes from general knowledge of the species: 0.35 m tall at 8 years in the open. Replace with measured data before calling this species calibrated.

appearance.note: Colours chosen by eye: dark glossy green fronds. Its stipes take their stated colour (stipe_colour).

taxon.note: Common name (and USDA symbol, where given) as the spec's authors wrote them.

growth_form.note: The growth form the spec's authors chose from the plant's habit.

growth.note: The growth plan (years, step, keyframes) chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

variants.note: The environments, conditions and seeds chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

taxon.family.note: WCVP v16's family for the accepted name.

taxon.plant_name_id.note: WCVP v16's plant_name_id for the accepted species the name resolves to (the accepted name).

taxon.scientific_name.note: WCVP v16's accepted name for the plant the spec's authors wrote as Struthiopteris spicant, which WCVP treats as a synonym.

taxon.genus.note: The genus WCVP v16's accepted name is written in.

traits.leaf_margin.note: Hoshizaki and Moran, Fern Grower's Manual (2001) p. 146, 147, Blechnum spicant: leaf margin entire.

traits.rosette.note: Hoshizaki and Moran, Fern Grower's Manual (2001) p. 221, 222, Blechnum spicant: rosette terminal; or clustered.

traits.frond_dimorphism.note: Hoshizaki and Moran, Fern Grower's Manual (2001) p. 221, 222, Blechnum spicant: frond dimorphism dimorphic.

traits.leaf_shape.note: The spec's value is from its `traits` note (abrams-1923). Hoshizaki and Moran, Fern Grower's Manual (2001) p. 221-222: blades lanceolate to narrowly elliptic. The spec stated {"linear": "usually", "oblanceolate": "often"}. Combined on the owner's rule (2026-10-15): where two sources differ, both are kept and the range spans them.

traits.rhizome_habit.note: The spec's value is from its `traits` note (abrams-1923). Hoshizaki and Moran, Fern Grower's Manual (2001) p. 221-222: rhizome erect, sometimes branched. The spec stated "short_creeping". Combined on the owner's rule (2026-10-15): where two sources differ, both are kept and the range spans them.
